(instance
  School
  Thing
  :source "A school has 12 boxes of pencils, 144 pencils in each.")

(instance
  Box
  Thing
  :source "A school has 12 boxes of pencils, 144 pencils in each.")
(instance Pencil Thing :source "250 pencils go to the office.")
(instance Class Class :source "The rest is shared equally among 31 classes.")
(import std.math.decimal-arith :symbols (div quot-of))
(import std.math.decimal :symbols (n))
(import std.math.arith :symbols (z))

(rule
  rest-asks-the-difference
  ()
  :match (and (count ?total Pencil) (count ?office Pencil) (rest-of ?total ?office ?r))
  :assert (div ?total ?office)
  :why "{?total} pencils, {?office} to the office: ask {?total} divided by {?office}")

(rule
  rest-is-the-quotient
  ()
  :match (and (count ?total Pencil) (count ?office Pencil) (quot-of ?total ?office ?q ?r))
  :assert (count ?q Pencil)
  :why "{?total} among {?office} is {?q} each and {?r} left")
(solve :no-search)
